purpose: High-signal Google searches for original ATS job boards. Queries are regenerated with a rolling date filter.

groups.label: Full Stack
groups.query: ("Full Stack Engineer" OR "Full Stack Developer" OR "Software Engineer") ("TypeScript" OR "React" OR "Angular" OR "Node.js")

groups.label: Frontend
groups.query: ("Frontend Engineer" OR "Angular Developer" OR "React Developer") ("TypeScript" OR "Angular" OR "React")

groups.label: Applied AI
groups.query: ("AI Product Engineer" OR "Applied AI Engineer" OR "AI Software Engineer" OR "Full Stack Engineer") ("LLM" OR "GenAI" OR "AI" OR "TypeScript")

groups.label: Founding / Early Engineer
groups.query: ("Founding Engineer" OR "Founding Software Engineer" OR "Early Engineer" OR "First Engineer") ("TypeScript" OR "React" OR "AI")

searchGroups.label: Full Stack (PT-BR)
searchGroups.query: ("Desenvolvedor Full Stack" OR "Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack" OR "Desenvolvedor Fullstack" OR "Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack" OR "Pessoa Desenvolvedora Full Stack") ("TypeScript" OR "React" OR "Angular" OR "Node.js" OR "JavaScript")

searchGroups.label: Frontend (PT-BR)
searchGroups.query: ("Desenvolvedor Frontend" OR "Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend" OR "Desenvolvedor Angular" OR "Desenvolvedor(a) Angular" OR "Desenvolvedor React" OR "Pessoa Desenvolvedora Frontend") ("TypeScript" OR "Angular" OR "React")

searchGroups.label: Software / Produto (PT-BR)
searchGroups.query: ("Engenheiro de Software" OR "Engenheira de Software" OR "Desenvolvedor de Software" OR "Desenvolvedor(a) de Software" OR "Pessoa Desenvolvedora") ("TypeScript" OR "React" OR "Angular" OR "Node.js" OR "API")

searchGroups.label: IA aplicada (PT-BR)
searchGroups.query: ("Engenheiro de IA" OR "Engenheira de IA" OR "Desenvolvedor de IA" OR "Desenvolvedor(a) de IA" OR "Inteligência Artificial" OR "Full Stack") ("IA" OR "AI" OR "LLM" OR "GenAI" OR "TypeScript")
